description: Fork of exp636 (three LUTs per block @ tph=1024 -> 467M, expected ~1.47 final). Single change: lut_tph 1024 -> 512 for all three LUTs (v_lut, out_lut, FFN lut). Halves LUT params per module (~12.6M each instead of ~25.2M). Total LUT params ~227M (vs exp636 453M), total params ~242M. Tests whether smaller tables per head help when three LUTs per block are present. Reference: exp635 (FFN+v at tph=1024) = 1.4301 @ 317M, exp636 (FFN+v+out at tph=1024) tracking ~1.47.
